title: Fixed Mine Shaft Headframe with Grooved Sheave
description: One original complete fixed mine shaft headframe appearance. Two tall front posts and two long raked rear stays carry separate top bearing rails, true through-bored axle housings, one whole horizontal fixed axle and a large six-spoke sheave with a genuinely recessed continuous rim groove. Offset rear diagonal braces and cross ties sit behind the front vertical shaft-mouth zone. One complete raised open rectangular shaft collar and four whole ground footplates define the support base. All geometry newly authored, no old swing, winch or portal mesh reused; generic fixed mesh construction only. Separate closed material components and intentionally embedded fixed frame/spoke joints, not a single welded shell or all-finite-interface proof. No rope, cage, winch, working shaft excavation, motion, hoisting, mining operation, load rating, engineering or safety claim. The preview ground remains visible through the collar; no underground pit is modelled.
